## Findings
- claim-1: The supplied formal text defines \(J_v:=\Bbbk\text{-span}\{\sigma_u:u\ge v\}\); it does not identify \(J_v/A_+J_v\). [source-2@L328-L337|claim=formal-document]
- claim-2: The supplied archive identifies its paper as *Presenting the cohomology of a Schubert variety*, arXiv:0809.2981v2, published in *Transactions of the American Mathematical Society* 363 (2011). [source-4@L3-L16|claim=ordinary-document]
- claim-3: The required certificate is not established from the supplied materials: no verifiable full-text copy associated with DOI \(10.1112/jlms.12832\), nor any indexed passage from such a copy stating its main theorem, coefficient hypotheses, or a description of \(J_v/A_+J_v\), is present.
## Strategy
No DOI-associated full-text artifact, stable identifier, digest, or indexed text is supplied. Therefore no ingestion or passage audit can be performed from the present record.

## Gaps
The certificate is unestablished. Missing are: a verifiable full-text copy tied bibliographically to DOI \(10.1112/jlms.12832\); integrity metadata; exact indexed theorem and coefficient passages; definitions of \(J_v,A_+\); and an exhaustive indexed audit of \(J_v/A_+J_v\) and equivalent terminology.

## Next
Provide the DOI-associated full-text artifact with immutable identifier and digest, then index and quote the specified passages and exhaustive search results.
